prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one square icon proposal for Watchtower, a companion app keeping watch over a developer's World of Warcraft addons.
Input images: the two supplied pictures are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match the family's hand-painted fantasy inventory illustration: chunky shapes, visible angular strokes, thick yellow-gold metal highlights, rich warm shadows and a quiet dark navy backdrop. Do not borrow their keys, handshake, circles, medallion framing or ribbons.
Subject: one stylised vigilant owl, an enchanted sentinel, seen straight on in a compact dignified pose. A large, expressive head with two slightly pointed ear tufts, a warm ivory heart-like facial disc, and two magnificent luminous turquoise eyes with clearly defined dark pupils under broad angular gold brows. Intelligent, calm and watchful, not angry or cartoon-baby cute. Give it a small gold hooked beak. Its round compact chest and folded wings are made from a few broad overlapping ivory and slate-blue feather shapes with chunky burnished-gold tips and edges, like a beautifully carved and enamelled owl figurine from Azeroth. The wings hug the body and taper into a short V at the base, tiny gold talons just visible. The face and eyes dominate, about half the object height, and the ears plus folded wings make a single strong recognisable owl silhouette. Not an owl sitting on anything. No perch, branch, pedestal, tower, lamp or other object. A precious small guardian icon rather than a realistic wildlife portrait. Painterly materials, gold fittings and broad enamel-like colour planes, no thin feather detail.
Composition/backdrop: centered, all parts visible, filling 85% of a full-bleed opaque midnight-navy square. Dark near-black corners with just a restrained cobalt painterly vignette close behind the owl. Warm gold rim highlights and cool ivory shadows. Keep the turquoise eyes bright and clear, but no magical rays, big aura or scattered stars. Visually distinct face even at 32-64px.
Medium: richly textured hand-painted high-fantasy game icon, bold angular brushwork, sculpted broad bevels, slightly exaggerated chunky proportions and dramatic contrast, same illustrator's family as the reference images. No smooth glossy 3D, photographs, flat vector graphics, corporate owl outline, shield shape, geometric dashboard, faction emblem, background scenery, full circular frame, wordmark, letters, numbers, runes, text, watermark, mockup or logo sheet. One finished icon.
